## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive — broad strength but risk/cycle ratios neutral; confirmed by HYG/LQD 1W strength (HYG (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +0.52%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -0.58%) RECOVERY) and VXX downside (VXX (1W: -10.57% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit easing apparent as HYG/LQD are rising (see above) indicating lower credit stress; equity breadth strong (8/11) supports risk appetite while stocks vs bonds remain mixed — SPY (1W: +4.31% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY vs TLT (1W: +0.24% | 1M: -1.67%) RECOVERY → neutral.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-accommodative: Dollar and rates flagged flat in the barometer; HYG (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +0.52%) ABOVE TREND shows credit marginally supportive while TLT (1W: +0.24% | 1M: -1.67%) RECOVERY keeps duration signals mixed.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech and semis leading: XLK (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing strength too (sector breadth Financials 1W: +4.54% | 1M: +1.35%). Style: Growth/Momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?  
US and EM both in recovery: SPY (1W: +4.31% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY and EEM (1W: +4.68% | 1M: -0.02%) RECOVERY; China FXI (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -0.95%) RECOVERY but lagging magnitude.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative risk is active: ARKK (1W: +8.25% | 1M: -5.03%) RECOVERY, IWM (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +0.98%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND show healthy risk-taking.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Commodity rally month-to-date led by oil exposures: USO (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +26.95%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +21.77%) CORRECTION, while metals show short-term recovery — GLD (1W: +4.16% | 1M: -8.81%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -13.17%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?  
Divergent: XLE (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION despite strong month, and UNG (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%) BELOW TREND highlights natural gas weakness.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed leadership in Tech/Sems and Small Caps — XLK (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +0.98%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence is minor (SPY and TLT showing RECOVERY while some commodities are in CORRECTION) — no major regime break.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure (XLK, SOXX, XBI) while reducing exposure to energy beta and natural gas (XLE, UNG); bonds and cash remain neutral — monitor credit spreads and VXX for regime shift.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology — XLK (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND; Semiconductors — SOXX (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION; Natural gas — UNG (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Broad crude exposure — USO (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +26.95%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Gas & seasonal softs — UNG (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%) BELOW TREND; CANE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: +4.22%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF relative = 1.0 (growth vs value tilt), USO momentum breakpoints tied to prior MTD highs.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, with credit and volatility signals neutral but sector breadth supportive. Tech/Sems showing the most relative strength — XLK (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND — watch the commodity/energy divergence (XLE (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION; UNG (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%) BELOW TREND) as the key risk trigger.
